subject.title: fix(ui): add timeout to control-ui bootstrap config fetch

question: Should Control UI permanently discard server bootstrap metadata and fall back to defaults when `/control-ui-config.json` has not responded within 15 seconds?
rationale: The deadline deliberately trades indefinite waiting for changed behavior on very slow deployments, and no existing documented Control UI contract establishes 15 seconds as the accepted cutoff.

options.title: Approve 15-second fallback
options.body: Accept the proposed deadline and fallback semantics as the Control UI bootstrap contract.

options.title: Choose a shared deadline
options.body: Replace the local value with an owner-approved shared bootstrap or browser-network deadline before merge.

options.title: Keep unbounded metadata loading
options.body: Do not impose a default deadline if valid late server metadata must always take precedence over fallback defaults.

recommendation.title: Approve 15-second fallback
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed deadline and fallback semantics as the Control UI bootstrap contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository contributor guidance identifies this handle with Control UI ownership.
